newsitem.title: USA: BEC Group Inc says to buy Bolle France.
newsitem.headline: BEC Group Inc says to buy Bolle France.

text.p: BEC Group Inc said Thursday it has signed a definitive agreement to acquire all of the share capital of Holding BF, the French holding company which owns Bolle France.
Principal terms of the acquisition, said the company, include a payout of $42 million cash.

BEC will also issue $10 million of BEC Group series A preferred stock, 928,571 shares of BEC Group common stock, and warrants to acquire about 10 percent of Bolle Inc common stock valued at $14 million.

The company said that following the completion of thge transaction, which is expected prior to July 10, it intends to split BEC Group into two public companies to maximize value for its shareholders, Bolle, a maker of eyewear. and ORC Technologies, a manufacturer of lighting, elctronic and electroformed products.
The company said in February that it had a letter of intent for the transaction.
